Agent Name: WebSurfer

Reason for Mistake: In the very first step, the WebSurfer agent incorrectly identified the director as "Carlos Torres Ríos" based on a misinterpretation of the search results (likely confusing the cinematographer, who is listed as Carlos Torres Ríos in the Wikipedia snippet visible in later turns, with the director). The correct director, Leopoldo Torres Ríos, is clearly visible in the same search results (e.g., "Directed by Leopoldo Torres Ríos" on the IMDb snippet), but the agent failed to extract this information correctly, leading to a foundational error in the entire conversation.
